plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: bottle anchors the left edge, logo stacked over the NEW FLAVOR pill as a compact brand column, a wide headline-led text block in the middle, and a full-height CTA closing the read on the right.

Brand-first strip: logo lockup opens on the left, the headline gets the widest possible block in the center, and the bottle sits directly beside the CTA so product and action read as one closing group, with the badge demoted to a small tag under the logo.

Message-first strip: the headline and subline lead from the left edge in a half-width block, then the bottle with its NEW FLAVOR pill beside it as a product group, and a right-hand stack of logo over CTA as the sign-off.
